title: Forbidden Patterns (lint-able)
note: check field is a description of a static/runtime check an agent or linter can implement; not literal executable code, but specific enough to translate into one directly

cross_cutting.check: grep animated CSS/JS for transition-property or gsap/motion calls targeting width|height|top|left|margin|padding; flag any match

cross_cutting.pattern: * { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; } as the sole reduced-motion strategy
cross_cutting.reason: breaks third-party widgets, strips intentional final-state design
cross_cutting.check: grep global stylesheet for a single blanket !important override with no per-component branches

cross_cutting.pattern: permanent will-change: transform on every animated element
cross_cutting.fix: apply will-change immediately before animation, remove on completion/onComplete
cross_cutting.check: grep CSS/inline styles for will-change not paired with a removal in JS (onComplete, cleanup fn)

cross_cutting.fix: pause on visibilitychange === 'hidden', resume on visible
cross_cutting.check: static analysis: every requestAnimationFrame call site has a paired visibilitychange listener in the same component/module

cross_cutting.reason: blocked by browser autoplay policy, fails silently
cross_cutting.check: grep for `new AudioContext()` or `Tone.start()` not inside an event handler callback

cross_cutting.reason: canvas has no intrinsic dimensions, causes INP/LCP regression
cross_cutting.fix: 2D poster image with explicit width/height is the LCP; canvas mounts after FCP
cross_cutting.check: Lighthouse: assert largestContentfulPaint element tagName !== 'CANVAS' and !== 'MODEL-VIEWER'

cross_cutting.reason: SEO bots and no-JS users see nothing
cross_cutting.fix: static with intrinsic dimensions inside
cross_cutting.check: grep hero component markup for canvas/model-viewer sibling with noscript or DOM-order poster image

cross_cutting.fix: cap active tracks, defer/stagger the rest
cross_cutting.check: runtime: count simultaneously-animating elements in viewport at any timestamp during Playwright trace

cross_cutting.pattern: modifier-click (Cmd/Ctrl/Shift+click) intercepted by custom routing/transition logic
cross_cutting.fix: check e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey and return early before preventDefault
cross_cutting.check: Playwright: Cmd+click a nav link, assert a new tab/context opens instead of SPA transition firing

cross_cutting.pattern: hover-only styling with no (hover:hover) media gate
cross_cutting.reason: touch devices get a stuck/awkward hover state
cross_cutting.fix: wrap :hover rules in @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)
cross_cutting.check: grep CSS for bare :hover selectors outside a (hover: hover) media block

kind-i.pattern: ScrollTrigger instance created without .kill() on unmount
kind-i.check: Playwright: unmount component tree, assert ScrollTrigger.getAll().length === 0
grep for lagSmoothing(0) and flag for manual review

kind-ii.pattern: frameloop='always' on pages with >5s of no interaction
kind-ii.check: flag any <Canvas> missing frameloop='demand' or a matching invalidate() call

kind-ii.pattern: WebGPURenderer used without navigator.gpu feature detection
kind-ii.check: grep for WebGPURenderer instantiation not preceded by an 'gpu' in navigator check

kind-iii.check: grep fragment shader source for gl_PointSize without a clamp/min()

kind-iv.check: Playwright: emulate touch device, assert no pointermove listener registered

kind-iv.pattern: focus ring replaced by motion-only feedback
kind-iv.check: Playwright: Tab to element, assert outline/outline-color changes independent of any transform

kind-v.check: Playwright: unmount, assert no lingering RAF via performance monitor

kind-vi.pattern: preloader visible for >5s with no hard timeout ceiling
kind-vi.check: grep for a setTimeout dismiss fallback alongside the window.load listener

kind-vii.check: grep for a `if (!document.startViewTransition)` branch near every call site

kind-viii.pattern: transition: all instead of enumerated properties

kind-ix.check: grep for particle loop bound not derived from motion.limit.concurrent

kind-x.pattern: MediaElementAudioSourceNode created without crossOrigin='anonymous' set first
kind-x.check: grep for createMediaElementSource call, verify crossOrigin assignment precedes it

kind-xi.pattern: USDZ shipped for non-iOS-only audience without a glTF counterpart
kind-xi.check: verify both a .glb and .usdz asset exist for the same model-viewer src set

kind-xii.check: grep for the inference call not gated behind a user-submit handler

kind-xii.pattern: no AbortController wired to a Cancel affordance
kind-xii.check: grep for fetch/stream call without a paired AbortController.abort() call site
